item.title: [Due in 3 days] Final reminder: the MemberOf rule operator stops processing on 3 November, and dynamic groups built on it freeze in their last state
item.description:
A group that stops recalculating does not fail loudly: it keeps whoever was in it on 3 November. A leaver stays in a group that grants access or a licence, a joiner never arrives in a group a Conditional Access policy targets, and an administrative unit stops following the population it was meant to scope. Nothing alerts, because nothing errors.

Entra · deadline 2026-11-03 · Query dynamic groups and administrative units for membership rules containing memberOf, list which Conditional Access policies, access packages and licence assignments target them, and replace each rule or convert the group to assigned membership before 3 November.

item.title: [New] Reminder: Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication retires from 1 February 2027; users with only SMS or voice get one last use, then must register a passkey
